title: Israel custom sites

vat.convention: All prices are before VAT and are written "+ מע״מ" on any quote. Business clients reclaim it.

note: Claude's estimate, for Shahar to correct. It prices one standalone custom site in Hebrew (RTL), sized like mutag-meitiv: 10–15 pages, the blog moved over from Wix, a CMS with team / services / case studies, motion and interaction. The market ranges come from the sources below. Our numbers are a judgement placed inside those ranges, not a fact. All amounts are before VAT (18% since 2025-01-01). Inbound one-off pitches carry no price (market.md); this list is for Shahar's own quotes.

offers.name: Self-hosted with CMS
offers.recurring: 0 to us; ~€6–12 / month (+ their VAT) to their VPS host
offers.buys: The designed site plus Payload + Postgres + the Astro builder + Caddy in one Docker Compose stack on the client's own VPS. We install it, verify publishing end to end, hand over every credential and a short runbook, then revoke our access. Nothing stays with Oneshot. 30 days of fixes after handover are included; after that, support is by the hour (300 / hour + מע״מ). Placed inside the 15,000–30,000 market range for a complex custom site and the 15,000–25,000 small-studio range for a business site.

offers.name: Managed
offers.recurring: 390 / month or 3,900 / year (2 months free), + מע״מ
offers.buys: We host it and they edit it: Cloudflare Worker, SSL, a CMS login for their site only, nightly backups, a rebuild on every save, uptime and updates handled by us, up to 1 hour of our edits a month. They get the static zip on exit, no lock-in. Lower setup fee than self-hosted because there is no install or handover. The monthly fee sits just above the market's all-in subscriptions (349 / month) and WordPress care plans (300 / month).

offers.name: Static only
offers.buys: The static build plus a source zip that runs on any host (GoDaddy included). No CMS, so every content change is billed by the hour. Only for an owner who will never edit.

offers.name: Domain (.co.il)
offers.recurring: OPEN, to be decided (see open[]); ~125 / year at an ISOC-IL accredited registrar
offers.buys: OPEN. CLAUDE.md says one Cloudflare Registrar domain per client, billed through. Cloudflare's TLD policy page lists no .il or .co.il (fetched 2026-10-18), so a .co.il may have to go through an ISOC-IL accredited registrar instead, which departs from CLAUDE.md and needs Shahar's decision. Not offered until decided; an existing domain is connected after a sale. A .com goes through Cloudflare Registrar at cost.

upsells.name: English version
upsells.note: A second locale on the same template (LTR mirror, hreflang, language switcher), with copy run through the full copy pipeline. Translation by the client, or quoted separately.

upsells.name: Arabic version
upsells.note: RTL like Hebrew, but needs its own fonts and a native reviewer. Translation is a pass-through cost.

upsells.name: Accessibility (IS 5568, AA)
upsells.note: The site is built to WCAG AA and ships with an accessibility statement page. Not an overlay plugin.

upsells.name: Independent accessibility audit
upsells.note: Manual review by an outside accessibility consultant, charged per unique template (the market quotes 800–2,000 per template; we expect ~4 templates). We fix whatever it finds in our template at no charge.

upsells.name: Blog migration from Wix
upsells.price: included up to 30 posts; then 40 / post + מע״מ
upsells.note: Posts, images, dates and old-URL 301 redirects so search rankings carry over. Claude's estimate; no source found.

upsells.name: Copywriting
upsells.note: New Hebrew copy for the main pages through our copy pipeline (the market quotes 2,000–5,000). Not needed when we only refresh existing text.

upsells.name: Photography
upsells.note: Booked with an Israeli photographer; we brief the shoot and do the art direction.

upsells.name: SEO + AI SEO refresh
upsells.note: Stations 4h–4i re-run on the live content, with a report. Claude's estimate.

upsells.name: Support hours (self-hosted / static)
upsells.note: Content changes, new sections, Payload and Docker updates. Sits at the experienced-freelancer rate (the market quotes 250–400 / hour).

upsells.name: Extra page or campaign page
upsells.note: One more page on the same template. Claude's estimate.

costs.cost: €5.99 / month and up, paid by the client
costs.note: Hetzner CAX11 after the 2026-06-15 price change; Payload + Postgres + builder may need the next plan up. Size the server before quoting.
Check the free-plan request limit against real traffic before promising it
Who registers and pays it is OPEN (see open[])
A custom multi-page site runs more rounds than an outbound one-pager
The real cost; not tracked. At 18,000 that is 180–300 / hour

terms: All prices before VAT; every quote and invoice says "+ מע״מ" (18%).
Payment in three parts: 30% on signing, 40% on design approval, 30% at launch or handover. This is the standard market split.
Prices are in shekels, paid by bank transfer or Bit. A tax invoice is issued for every payment.
Self-hosted: handover is complete once the client confirms they can log in and publish, and we confirm our access is removed.
Managed: month to month, cancel any time; on exit the client gets the static zip and their domain stays theirs. The managed price is fixed for 12 months.
The quote includes two rounds of design revisions; further rounds are billed by the hour.
open: The numbers: keep, raise or lower? Market ranges are 15,000–30,000 for a complex custom site and 8,000–25,000 for a 5–7 page site.
Is Shahar an עוסק מורשה (charges 18% VAT) or an עוסק פטור (charges no VAT)? This changes every quote.
Should the install and handover fee be separate, or folded into the site price?
How many days of included fixes after handover: 30, or more?

Domains (.co.il): can a .co.il go through Cloudflare Registrar (CLAUDE.md: one Cloudflare Registrar domain per client)? Its TLD policy page lists no .il or .co.il (fetched 2026-10-18). If not, use an ISOC-IL accredited registrar instead: that departs from CLAUDE.md and needs Shahar's decision, including whether we resell it or the client registers it in their own name.
Payment: is bank transfer plus Bit enough, or do we also need a card link (e.g. through an Israeli invoicing service)?

sources.name: Itay Ost, website pricing guide (Hebrew)
sources.says: Before VAT. 5–7 page branding site: 8,000–15,000 (freelancer), 15,000–25,000 (small studio), 30,000–50,000 (large studio). Advanced business site: 15,000–25,000 / 25,000–40,000. Maintenance 500–3,000 / month; content 2,000–5,000; photography 1,500–4,000; domain 50–120 / year. Hourly: 250–400 (experienced), 300–700 (studio). Payment 30/40/30.

sources.name: The Boss, small-business website cost 2026
sources.says: Multi-page branding site 4,000–6,000; custom complex site 15,000–30,000; ongoing cost 200–600 / month; one market example sells an all-in subscription at 349 / month and migration at 1,500.

sources.name: Edens Design, website cost 2026
sources.says: Freelancer template site 1,500–6,000; custom-code site 7,000–15,000; complex content site 15,000+; most quotes are before VAT.

sources.name: Midrag, website building prices
sources.says: Template branding site 3,500–5,000; landing page 1,000–3,500; Wix hosting 63–133 / month; extra changes ~150 / hour. This is the low, template end of the market.

sources.name: Savvy, WordPress maintenance
sources.says: Monthly WordPress maintenance from 300 + VAT, month to month.

sources.name: Tabnav, cost of accessibility to IS 5568
sources.says: Plugin plus scans 600–1,200 / year; manual adjustments or reviews 800–2,000 per unique template; cost scales with templates, not page count.

sources.name: Cloudflare TLD policies
sources.says: No .il or .co.il in Cloudflare Registrar's supported list.

sources.name: Domain The Net (ISOC-IL accredited registrar), .co.il
sources.says: .co.il registration 125 / year (the page does not say whether VAT is included).

sources.name: PrivateDevOps, Hetzner June 2026 repricing
sources.says: For new orders: CAX11 went from €4.49 to €5.99 / month, CX23 from €3.99 to €5.49.
